boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the Fortin Road corridor immediately beside URI’s Kingston campus.

cards.title: Kingston Emporium
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, at the top of campus
cards.notes: Walk up Fortin Road to orient yourself to the cluster of quick-service restaurants at 99 Fortin Road before choosing a meal stop.
cards.short_summary: A named food destination immediately beside the Kingston campus.
cards.evidence_claim: URI identifies the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road and says it offers several quick-service restaurants.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: The cited URI page places the Emporium at 99 Fortin Road, at the top of campus.

cards.title: Providence Bagel
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Use the Fortin Road walk to reach Providence Bagel inside the Kingston Emporium when you want a bagel-focused quick-service option.
cards.short_summary: A bagel stop listed by URI in the Fortin Road Emporium.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Providence Bagel among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located within the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road, according to URI.

cards.title: International Pocket Cafe
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Head to the Fortin Road Emporium for International Pocket Cafe and use its official menu site to review offerings before you go.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean and Middle Eastern food stop at the Emporium.
cards.evidence_claim: International Pocket Cafe’s official site gives its Kingston address as 99 Fortin Road.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 99 Fortin Road, Kingston.

cards.title: Sumo Sushi
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Make Sumo Sushi a Fortin Road food stop by walking to the Emporium and checking the restaurant’s current service details before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A sushi option named by URI at the Fortin Road Emporium.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Sumo Sushi among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: URI places this restaurant in the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road.

cards.title: Simply Thai
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Walk the Fortin Road corridor to the Emporium for Simply Thai, then confirm current menu and service information directly with the business.
cards.short_summary: A Thai-food destination listed at the Fortin Road Emporium.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Simply Thai among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: URI places this restaurant in the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road.

cards.title: Albie’s Place
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Use Albie’s Place as a Fortin Road lunch or dinner option and check its posted ordering or service details before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service sandwich-shop stop on the URI-adjacent corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2025 Rhode Island Secretary of State filing identifies Albie’s Place at 99 Fortin Road as a quick-serve food and sandwich shop.
cards.access_notes: The state filing lists the principal business office at 99 Fortin Road, Kingston.

cards.title: High 1 Pizza
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Walk to the Fortin Road Emporium for High 1 Pizza, and verify current menu choices with the operator before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A pizza destination included in URI’s Emporium listing.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists High 1 Pizza among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: URI places this restaurant in the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road.

cards.title: Stack House
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Use the short Fortin Road walk to reach Stack House at the Emporium, then consult the business for current offerings before you visit.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service stop on the URI-adjacent Fortin Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Stack House among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: URI places this restaurant in the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road.

cards.title: Krazy Fusion Cafe
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, Kingston Emporium
cards.notes: Add Krazy Fusion Cafe to a Fortin Road food walk and check current service information with the business before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant in URI’s list of Emporium tenants.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Krazy Fusion Cafe among the quick-service restaurants at the Kingston Emporium, 99 Fortin Road.
cards.source_title: Food — URI College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: URI places this restaurant in the Kingston Emporium at 99 Fortin Road.

cards.title: Caliente Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: Fortin Road corridor, beside the URI Quad
cards.notes: Follow Fortin Road to Caliente Mexican Grill beside the URI Quad; its location page provides current hours and ordering information.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican-grill stop explicitly described as beside the URI Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Caliente Mexican Grill’s official URI location page lists 99 Fortin Road, describes it as next to the URI Quad, and posts hours.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 99 Fortin Road; posted hours are Sunday–Thursday 10 a.m.–11 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–11 p.m.
